spans.text: 8pm, December 25. At a subway station near the base.
The Christmas event will end in half an hour. Would all T-Dolls please register your entry and log the number of Christmas Coins you have obtained.
The final results will be tallied and announced in 30 minutes. You are all welcome to watch the livestream at the Café.
The broadcast is repeated every now and then. Upon hearing it, Dolls would head to the Café, bubbling with excitement.
At the entrance of the busy subway station, TMP stamps her feet anxiously, waiting for her call to connect.
K2, why aren't you picking up...?
While she is waiting, she scrolls through her call logs.
M950A, Thunder, K2, AEK-999...
A long list of missed calls.
Where...is everybody...?
TMP sits down dejectedly on the stairs when her communicator finally chirps.
K2, you're finally returning my calls!
Oh, sorry. We've been a bit busy.
Lots of work tonight?
Um... Yeah, haha.
The Christmas event is about to end. I was hoping—
An ear-splitting screech of brakes can be heard coming from K2's end.
Your driving sucks!
Sorry, TMP. I gotta go. Talk to you later.
Okay...
K2 hangs up hurriedly. Clutching at her communicator, TMP thinks about her friends in the frigid wind.
Meanwhile, at the entrance of the lively Café.
The Café is crammed full of Dolls, so Suomi and Am RFB are stuck in a queue outside.
Suomi looks away from the direction in which TMP has left and asks Am RFB.
Shouldn't we go and check on her? She seems really down.
No, just give her some space.
The two Dolls stop talking. Am RFB takes out her gaming device, settles into a comfortable position, and starts playing.
RFB?
Suomi notices that Am RFB has already put on her eye-catching gaming headset.
RFB, I actually have a lot to tell you.
Am RFB is deftly operating her console with nimble fingers.
But what I want to say the most is...
Thank you for playing video games with me.
Suomi finally spoke her mind, but Am RFB didn't hear it. She feels relieved, yet also wistful.
At the same time, in the hallway near the Café.
Seeing that there is a much longer queue outside the Café than they expected, M21 and M14 decide to watch the livestream back in their dorm.
...What a busy night! We were hoping we could talk to the Commander for a bit.
But the Commander is surrounded by so many Dolls it's impossible to get through at all.
We'll leave it till next time. What about you, M21?
Uh... Um... Yeah...
What's the matter with you, M21? You've been pretty absent-minded these last couple of days.
...Oh, nothing.
You must tell us if there's something wrong.
Right.
M21 stops pensively.
Um... M14... Actually...
When she looks up again, M14 suddenly lunges at her and covers her mouth with a hand.
I... (muffled speech)
Hush! Look!
Miss Helian is drunk...
Oh no, she's falling off the stairs!
M14 immediately rushes over to the stairs.
Hey, M14! I...
M21 shouts weakly. In the end, she just chuckles bitterly and follows M14.
I'll probably never get these words out to M14...
Meanwhile, in the hallway.
In the still air of the dark passage, a shadowy figure ambushes another shadowy figure.
Long time no see.
Indeed.
But such a passionate greeting is hardly necessary, is it?
Px4 Storm looks down at the gift-wrapping ribbon that has been tied tightly around her. If she remembers correctly, it's the exact same ribbon that she used to tie up CAWS.
If I didn't do this, you would never listen to me properly.
I don't think I want to hear a word of what you're about to say.
Why don't you start by telling me where you stashed those Christmas Coins?
I know you didn't log them in your event acquisition.
You're right, but I don't plan on sharing this piece of information with you.
You don't have to. I already know.
Not only the coins' location, but also what really happened on the expedition a month ago.
Ha, so you've found out...
I'm going to tell the others everything.
Is that a threat?
In the dark, the motionless air grows heavy and dangerous.
At the same time, near the base.
100 Shiki and FP-6 have come to inspect the site of the fireworks at the Commander's behest.
...Gosh, I'm exhausted. The inspection is basically complete. We can notify the Commander and the Fireworks Fairy.
Are the launchers with you?
Yep! They're good to go.
I'll contact the Commander and confirm the time.
Shall I go up and check the roof again?
Sure.
100 Shiki makes sure that the launchers are still intact before heading up to the rooftop.
Even though the fireworks have been checked thoroughly and repeatedly, she is still a bit worried.
This might be the last task that she will carry out together with FP-6.
The positions are just as indicated on the plan; nothing has been moved.
The fireworks are also dry and untouched by the snow; they should go off just fine.
FP-6, I'm done over h—
100 Shiki turns to look at FP-6 and steps onto the frosty roof tiles with her shoes, which don't have anti-slip soles.
Ah!
100 Shiki!
100 Shiki slips and starts rolling down.
Help!
Don't worry, I got you!
Slam!
After the disorienting impact, all 100 Shiki sees is the white snow dancing through the sky.
8pm, December 25—Christmas Day. At the busy Café.
The Dolls are gathered at the Café, anxiously awaiting the announcement in half an hour.
Betty, try to steal more Christmas Coins! The tally will be closed soon...
I've already given away my Christmas Coin... Will my button do?
Everyone is soooo cute! It doesn't matter if I win or not...
Unlike the excited Dolls all around, the Commander is obviously dog-tired and desperate for the event to end.
Commander, you seem to have had a few very busy days?
Thanks to you, I've spent the last couple of days as some kind of fugitive.
Which just goes to show that a lot of Dolls are very grateful to you. It's their way of showing their love.
Kalina, are you sure this event will be a success?
Of course! When have I ever messed up an event?
You're right, your events never give me cause for worry.
I didn't know you trust me so much, Commander!
I thought you were still hung up on the bill for last year's Christmas event...
...Let bygones be bygones.
Thank you for still believing in me.
Kalina takes out her Christmas Coin from her pocket.
I'm sure you've already received a heap of Christmas Coins, but I'd still like to give you mine as a show of my gratitude.
Kalin, each coin carries its own unique sentiment.
That's exactly right! Just as each Christmas event has its own unique purpose!
But you ended up wrecking the base last year...
I knew it! You ARE still hung up on that!
Ahem... I didn't mean to blame you. It's more of a gentle reminder.
I've learned my lesson. All flammable and explosive dinergates are banned!
Good. Then let's look forward to how the event will turn out this year.
I won't let you down!
After checking the time, Kalina turns on the broadcast.
Attention, all Griffin employees, would everyone please gather around. The next phase of the event is about to begin!
Whoosh... Bang!
Before Kalina can give the signal, the fireworks have already snaked up the sky and exploded.
What's going on...? Eh, nevermind!
Ahem, that's right! This is our surprise for tonight! A fireworks show!
While we are all waiting for the results, please enjoy the beautiful fireworks spectacle!
The dazzling fireworks draw the Dolls to the windows.
Why has FP-6 launched the fireworks early?
Maybe there's been a misunderstanding?
I can't seem to get in touch with her...
I'll send the Fireworks Fairy over to check on them!
Meanwhile, near the base.
100 Shiki, filled with guilt and sadness, is sitting next to the chimney with her arms around her knees.
I'm so sorry...
I told you, it's not your fault.
Because of the collision, FP-6, who had been resting by the chimney, is now stuck firmly in the chimney itself.
Both of their communicators have been damaged, and the firework launchers are nowhere to be found.
At least the fireworks got set off.
But we didn't confirm the time with the Commander...
It's okay. We'll give a full report once we're back.
I'm sorry... I keep causing you trouble...
Hey... You can't go to the Christmas party all because I'm stuck.
Besides, you've been a great help to me these last couple of days, 100 Shiki...
Actually, I let Px4 Storm go.
100 Shiki proceeds to confess everything to FP-6. She hoped that coming clean would liberate her from the guilt, but now the frozen silence is weighing heavily on her shoulders.
I'm sorry... If I had just been a bit more steadfast, we could've got another Christmas Coin...
And you could've won the contest...
It doesn't matter anymore.
I know Px4 Storm is a master manipulator, but I didn't expect she managed to talk you into lying to me.
There's still time to dig up the rest of the Christmas Coins from under the tree. I remember the coordinates; it's not far from here.
You don't have to.
No... Let me make it up to you!
Ignoring FP-6's protests, 100 Shiki slides off the roof and runs towards the "Tree of Friendship".
She digs through the loose dirt and finds the red Christmas stocking into which she has put her Christmas Coin.
FP-6! Look!
100 Shiki lifts up the stocking to show FP-6, but its unexpected weight catches her by surprise.
...M-My coin turned into stone!!!
I'm so sorry...
100 Shiki shuffles back to FP-6's side dejectedly.
I'm such an idiot... I actually believed Px4 Storm's nonsense about magic...
I will gladly accept any punishment...
You'll gladly accept punishment, eh? Then give me your hand.
100 Shiki stretches out a hand gingerly, waiting for her unknown punishment.
But the only thing she feels in her palm is a cold hard coin.
It's FP-6's Christmas Coin.
I punish you by giving you my Christmas Coin. You did such a fantastic job these last few days you deserve the punishment.
Huh...?
I've never really cared about winning the event. To me, it has always been just a mission.
But you were so motivated and gave everything your best effort, it made me oddly fired up as well.
100 Shiki, you've been a wonderful partner. Thank you for giving up your own chance of getting Christmas Coins to help me keep this event safe and fair.
I should be the one to thank you...
Tears streak down 100 Shiki's face.
She puts the Christmas stocking stuffed full of rocks off to the side and takes the memory stick out of her pocket.
FP-6, let's listen to some music together...
Sure.
She gives one of her earbuds to FP-6 and cranks up the volume to the maximum...
Meanwhile, in the hallway.
Whoosh... Bang!
Another firework shoots up, and the dark night sky is illuminated by the brilliant sparks.
The remaining cinders trail off, their descent reflected in CAWS' eyes.
You sold the rest of the Christmas Coins.
CAWS towers over Px4 Storm, whom she has captured and bound up.
Well done for figuring that out.
Who'd have thought there were people that would spend that kind of money on buying Griffin merch.
I've gotta say, I was pretty tempted when I realized how lucrative this is.
I'm afraid you'll have to give up on that idea, seeing that I have monopoly over this market.
Since you've turned quite a decent profit, where's the money?
If you're trying to blackmail me, I'm sorry, but I've already spent it all.
A miser like you would blow that much money all at once? I don't believe you.
CAWS kneels down and starts playing her audio recordings next to Px4 Storm's ear.
"Px4 Storm often comes to visit us and she always brings a lot of presents for us!"
"Px4 Storm is the best!"
"Px4 Storm would tell me bedtime stories. I miss her a lot..."
Stop it! You...
I followed you secretly to the orphanage near the base.
I'd never have imagined you spending money on buying presents for the human children there.
This is absolutely hilarious. If I hadn't seen it for myself, I would've wondered if I'd somehow ended up in some kind of parallel universe.
A Doll who makes fun of others for being naïve is actually pretty naïve herself.
You have your reasons; I won't pry into your business.
Thanks.
But answer the rest of my questions.
What other questions do you have? On the expedition a month ago, I dug you guys out from under the snow. But you know that already, don't you?
Yeah, but why didn't you tell anyone about that?
What's there to tell? I was just doing my job.
I know I often cut corners just so I can take care of some side gigs, but I have no intention of losing this job.
So can you let me go now?
I'm sure you can get out of that in 10 minutes.
Hm?
CAWS stuffs a cold coin into Px4 Storm's pocket.
Merry Christmas.
It's CAWS' own Christmas Coin.
Px4 Storm sits there on the floor, utterly stunned. She watches as CAWS' receding back vanishes in the dark.
Merry Christmas.
Meanwhile, in the Griffin dorms.
After hauling a completely smashed Helian back to her room, M14 and M21 return to their dorm.
We wonder why Miss Helian has drunk so much...
She kept muttering about blowing things up…and blind dates...
Maybe she went through something rough...
We hope she'll cheer up once she sobers up.
M14 heads over to her bedside table and starts rummaging through the drawer.
M21 musters her courage and walks up to her.
M14... If, hypothetically speaking...
If you still had your Christmas Coin...
Would you give it to me?
Hm... Probably not...
Why...?
Because I got you something even better.
I've been working so— What?
M14 takes a beautifully wrapped present out of her drawer.
The Christmas Coin is just some random coin. It doesn't matter whom we give it to.
But we spent a lot of time picking out this present, and it's only meant for you, M21.
(Sobs) Thank you, M14!
M21 warmly embraces M14.
You seem to care a lot about this Christmas Coin thing. It must mean a lot to you.
Yes...
Then can we have your Christmas Coin?
Absolutely!
M21 exclaims enthusiastically, but then she suddenly remembers the fate of her Christmas Coin...
I...I need to go to the bathroom...
What—
In the howling wind, M21 dashes toward the window out of which she has tossed her Christmas Coin...
Meanwhile, at the entrance of the lively Café.
Am RFB takes off her headphones in a daze.
Suomi, my console was muted...
But thank you, Suomi!
I had a lot of fun these last few days!
It was also amazing playing with you at the game night!
...Thanks.
You know what, I should give you my Christmas Coin.
Am RFB smacks herself on the forehead and offers Suomi her Christmas Coin.
Suppressing her elation, Suomi takes the coin with feigned casualness.
Then here's mine in return.
Suomi's Christmas Coin now lies in Am RFB's palm.
AAAAAAAAAAAAH... My WISH HAS COME TRUE...
What a wonderful Christmas...
Thanks for your coin.
Even though Suomi is practically screaming on the inside, her face is as impassive as ever.
Woohoo, I got Suomi's Christmas Coin! I wonder if I can fool the machines at the arcade into taking it.
Thanks for this too.
The two Dolls behold their respective Christmas Coins. A goofy smile appears on both their faces at the same time.
Meanwhile, at the subway station near the base.
TMP rises to her feet and decides it's about time she headed back to the Café.
After walking a few steps, a question suddenly occurs to her.
The image quality of K2's call seemed pretty high just now?
Have they finally worked on improving the network connection over there...? But I haven't heard about any work being done?
TMP!
As the final train of the day pulls into the station, a shout comes from behind.
Who's that?
T!
M!
P!
Oh my gosh, you're back!
TMP lets out a gleeful yelp and dives into her long-awaited group hug.
8.30pm, December 25. At the Café.
It's time to reveal the results!
So who's the winner?
I don't know either. The Dolls have all logged how many coins they managed to obtain and the computer in the command room is sorting through the data.
Once it's done, we'll have the answer.
What if the computer crashes? Won't we lose all the data?
Impossible! Persica has sworn on her honor that the new computer is absolutely dependable!
It's almost time, my dear Dolls! Here comes the most thrilling part!
Raise your hands and count down with me!
A countdown timer is projected on the screen in the Café. The flickering numbers are reflected in the Dolls' bright eyes.
...Let us keep our attention on the screen, where the winner of this event will be revealed!
The screen rotates through the names and ID pictures of all the Dolls.
The cheers reach the peak of excitement as Kalina raises her index finger to indicate the final number...
Just before the screen comes to a final stop...
Bang! Boom! A series of fireworks go off at exactly the same time.
The lights in the Café flicker and go out, even the screen goes dark.
What happened? The fireworks...
Kalina, the screen went dark...
...Does this mean the computer crashed?
I'll contact Persica!
Kalina walks over to the corner and confirms the terrible truth in just a few seconds.
Commander...
Just tell me. I can take it.
The fireworks blew up the command room... The computer crashed...
Having no idea about what just happened, the Dolls start chattering in confusion, and the joyous atmosphere is on the verge of being shattered.
What should we do, Commander?!
Get the Fairies to clean up the scene and wrap up this event nicely.
We've made it this far, we must at least make sure everyone leaves happy.
Make sure everyone leaves happy... I've got it!
Kalina shakes off her panic and resumes her broadcast.
Apologies, everyone. Our system just experienced a little malfunction. We are currently repairing it as fast as we can!
Huh? No way!
Boo!
But don't go just yet! Although the biggest question of the night will have to wait for a while...
There is still the second biggest question!
Looking at Kalina's gleeful smile, a chill runs down the Commander's spine.
That's right, the question that all of you are burning to ask...
Who has the Commander's Christmas Coin?!
...I knew it!
The Commander sees this coming and takes off running, but it's already too late.
Darling, it's time you made your choice!
I'm sure you will choose me without hesitation...
No, no, no! Honey's Christmas Coin is mine! It's been decided since long ago!
You're lying!
Right, Honey?!
Um...
Darling...you won't let me down, will you?
Let me have your Christmas Coin, Honey! ♪
Gotcha, Darling! Now give me your Christmas Coin!
Screw off, old hag! The Commander's Christmas Coin belongs to me!
Commander... Why don't we spend some time alone, just the two of us?
I'll trade my exclusive summer swimsuit photo album for your Christmas Coin.
Surrounded by all the Dolls, the Commander keeps backing away.
HELP!!!
With a desperate howl, the Commander sprints out into the cold and snowy night...
Of course, the Commander is never alone.
Commander/Darling/Honey/Caretaker/Little Lamb/Boss, wait for me!!!
One Coin Short – END
December 25, Christmas Day. Near the base.
The Fireworks Fairy was finally done with setting up all the fireworks.
Phew, I'm beat!
Cling. Clang...
An empty wine bottle rolled down the slope over to the Fairy.
Who's there?! Don't you know it's super dangerous to drink near this pile of fireworks?
Don't just toss away your bottle!
Why...the hell...did I...
PLAY DEATH METAL ON MY BLIND DATE?!!!!
The Fireworks Fairy picked up the wine bottle huffily while a dark figure stumbled unsteadily towards it.
M-Miss Helian?
Blind date! Work! Burn them all!
Christmas! Holy Night! BURN THEM ALL!!!
...Are you okay? You seem drunk, Miss Helian.
Heheh... I have a wish...
A wish... Px4 Storm said that Christmas is a time for making people's wishes come true!
What do you wish for, Miss Helian?
I want to blow up the place where I made a complete fool of myself! Blow it all up! HAHAHAHAHAHA!
Helian pointed toward the command room with the bottle in her hand.
Is that supposed to make any sense?
But then again, humans never wish for things that make sense...
I understand. I'll do my best!
The Fireworks Fairy clutched tightly at the firework launcher in her hand and swore to herself that she would make Helian's wish come true.
One Coin Short – END! For Real!
